sentences.text: Meridiosaurus is an extinct genus of mesoeucrocodylian, a group of crocodile relatives, belonging to the family Pholidosauridae.
The genus was described in 1980 based on a partial rostrum containing the premaxillae and most of the maxillae.
Fossils of Meridiosaurus have been found in the Late Jurassic Tacuarembó Formation in Tacuarembó, Uruguay.
Meridiosaurus lived during the Kimmeridgian to Tithonian stages, from 154.8 to 143.1 million years ago.
While some authors doubt the assignment of Meridiosaurus to Pholidosauridae, a 2011 redescription and phylogenetic analysis confirmed this classification.
